cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(rkdeveloptool VERSION 1.32 LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(LIBUSB REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libusb-1.0)
configure_file(config.h.in config.h @ONLY)
add_executable(rkdeveloptool main.cpp crc.cpp RKBoot.cpp RKComm.cpp RKDevice.cpp RKImage.cpp RKLog.cpp RKScan.cpp)
target_compile_features(rkdeveloptool PRIVATE cxx_std_11)
target_compile_definitions(rkdeveloptool PRIVATE _FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 _LARGE_FILE)
target_compile_options(rkdeveloptool PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror=return-type -Werror=format-security -fno-strict-aliasing)
target_include_directories(rkdeveloptool PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(rkdeveloptool PRIVATE PkgConfig::LIBUSB)
option(W132D_STATIC "Link a standalone Linux executable" OFF)
if(W132D_STATIC)
    target_link_options(rkdeveloptool PRIVATE -static)
endif()
install(TARGETS rkdeveloptool RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
